title: [Routine Help] Need Help Finding a Better Moisturizer and a Retinol
text:
Hello! My skin is on the drier side, and I do not generally struggle with acne. I get closed comedones on my forehead, and blackheads on/on the sides of my nose. I get the occasional pimple (once every 2 months or so).

I have no problems with any part of my routine except (a) Origins recently changed the formula of their moisturizer, and it has been giving me pimples/whiteheads on my cheeks, and (b) I don't use a retinol and want to start.

For (a), I would love recommendations to simple, gentle (but effective), non-comedogenic moisturizers. Preferably SPF-free, as I layer with SPF in the AM. I've heard CeraVe PM and La Roche Posay are good, but I've also seen some reviews saying that they caused comedones or acne.

For (b), I would love a starter retinol to incorporate every other night instead of my AHA serum. I have heard Obagi 0.5 is a good place to start, but wanted confirmation or other recommendations.

Any other comemnts/help with my routine would be much appreciated. Thank you so much in advance!

My current routine is as follows:

AM:

* La Roche Posay Toleriane Purifying Cleanser
* OleHenriksen Truth Serum (Vitamin C Serum)
* Origins Ginzing Oil-Free Energy Boosting Gel Moisturizer
* Neutragena Clear Face Breakout-Free Liquid Lotion SPF 55
* Colorescience Total Eye Renewal Therapy 3-in-1 SPF 35 (on eye area)
* Vanicream Lip Protectant (on lips)

PM:

* Farmacy Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm
* La Roche Posay Toleriane Purifying Cleanser
* OleHenriksen Invigorating Night Transformation Gel (AHA Serum)
* Origins Ginzing Oil-Free Energy Boosting Gel Moisturizer
* CeraVe Healing Ointment (on lips)

Occasional:

* Origins Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask
* Neutrogena Rapid Clear Acne Eliminating Spot Treatment Gel with Witch Hazel and Salicylic Acid
